name: Minna, Oru?

boost.name: Princess Wave
effect: Draw a card.
HIT: Draw a card.
description: 參考她每次直播的開場白『みんな、おる？』（大家在嗎？），粉絲會回應『おるよ～』。此卡以極速進行試探攻擊並抽牌，象徵她與Lu-knights之間的互動默契。

name: Nna-shoi!

boost.name: Jump In
effect: Move 1 space and Strike.
HIT: Push opponent 1 space. You may close the distance by 1 space.
description: 招牌叫聲『んなーしょい！』是她直播中的攻擊/跳躍音效，也被粉絲用作遮蓋敏感話題的代替詞。此卡靈活突進並控制距離，體現她嬌小卻充滿活力的戰鬥風格。

name: Nanora?

boost.name: Yare Yare Nanora
effect: Cancel the effect of the opponent's last boost card.
BEFORE: Discard 1 card. If you do, negate the opponent's attack.
description: 『なんなのら？』（搞什麼啦？）和『やれやれなのら』（唉呀呀）是她在不滿或證明對方錯誤時的口頭禪。此防禦卡展現她嬌小身軀下的頑強，以困惑與吐槽化解對手攻勢。

name: Candy Kingdom's Gift

boost.name: Sweet Treat
effect: Gain 2 life.
HIT: Gain 3 life.
description: 來自糖果王國的甜蜜禮物。參考她出身於異世界糖果王國的公主設定，以糖果和甜點來治癒自己與Lu-knights，象徵她溫柔關懷的一面。

name: Moon Crest

boost.name: Lunar Blessing
effect: Choose a card from your Gauge and add it to your hand.
BEFORE: Return 1 card from your Gauge to your hand.
description: 參考她身上的月亮造型飾品——據說是異世界祖國的紋章。此卡象徵月光的神秘力量，能回收資源，體現她與月亮的特殊連結與血脈中的力量。

name: Battle Princess

boost.name: Dark Souls Veteran
effect: Ignore Armor. AFTER: Take 1 damage.
Ignore Guard.
description: 參考她在Dark Souls系列展現的驚人實力而被粉絲稱為『戦姫』（Battle Princess）。此卡展現可愛公主外表下的戰鬥本能——近距離高火力、無視防禦，體現極致反差萌。

name: Luna no Kachii!

boost.name: Victory Declaration
effect: +2 Power. HIT: Gain Advantage.
HIT: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 勝利宣言『ルーナのかちい！』（Luna贏了！）。參考她極度好勝的性格，贏得遊戲時總會驕傲宣布勝利。此卡象徵她轉守為攻、奪取主導權的能力。

name: Butler's Warning

boost.name: Pointed Glare
effect: Look at opponent's hand. Choose 1 card; they discard it unless they pay 1G.
BEFORE: Opponent reveals their hand. Choose 1 card; they discard it.
description: 參考她的執事ちゃん（管家），總在身邊並在她太囂張時管教她。此卡代表公主也有被約束的一面，以管家的威嚴干擾對手策略、破壞手牌。

name: Escort Me! Luknight

boost.name: Knight Order Charge
effect: Add up to 2 cards from your hand to your Gauge. For each card added, gain 1 life.
BEFORE: +1 Power for each card in your Gauge (max +4).
HIT: Push opponent 2 spaces. You may close the distance by 1 space.
description: 參考原創曲〈Escort me! Luknight〉，歌詞描述公主召喚Lu-knights護航。作為Ultra卡展現Lu-knights的忠誠與力量——蓄積的資源越多，攻擊越強大。

name: Nnasshoi Passion

boost.name: Full Moon
effect: Regain 4 life. Until the end of your next turn, you have Stun Immunity.
Stun Immunity.
BEFORE: You may discard any number of cards. +1 Power and +1 Speed per card discarded.
AFTER: If this attack hit, gain Advantage.
description: 參考2025年原創曲〈Nnasshoi Passion〉，融合招牌口號『んなーしょい』與Passion。作為最終奧義Ultra卡，燃燒所有能量發動毀滅一擊——捨棄越多、力量越強，象徵她的熱情與成長。
